# Architecture

The repository is a small evidence engine in four layers. Each layer reads the layers below it and never imports a layer above it. `tests/test_import_contract.py` reads every import statically and fails on an upward import, a dynamic import, an unlisted third party package, or any LLM or network client. No model sits in any decision path.

```
data       data/  assurance/  schema/            CSV, YAML and JSON, no code
  |
tools      tools/*.py                            validate, check, render, generate schemas
  |                                              (standard library and PyYAML)
sim        sim/*.py                              seeded synthetic models, scoring, evidence bundles
  |                                              (standard library and numpy)
docsgen    docsgen/*.py                          fills documents from data and results
```

## Contracts first

| Contract | Defined in | Generated artefact | Staleness test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Evidence table columns, value sets, formats | `tools/contracts.py` (`EVIDENCE_TABLE`) | `schema/evidence_table.schema.json` | `tests/test_schema.py` |
| Assurance case node kinds and fields | `tools/contracts.py` (`CASE`) | `schema/assurance_case.schema.json` | `tests/test_schema.py` |
| Simulation result files | `sim/common.py` (`envelope`) | `sim/results/*.json` | `tests/test_sim_results.py` |
| Evidence bundles cited by the case | `sim/evidence.py` | `sim/results/EV-08.json`, `sim/results/EV-12.json` | `tests/test_sim_results.py` |
| Generated documents | `docs/templates/*.tmpl.md`, `docsgen/facts.py` | `README.md`, `HANDOFF.md`, `docs/*.md` listed in `docsgen/build.py` | `tests/test_docs.py` |
| Assurance case diagram | `tools/ac_render.py` | `figures/gsn_library_robot.dot` (SVG and PNG rendered in CI) | `tests/test_ac_check.py` |

The validator and the checker take their value sets from the contract, so the schema, the checks and the data cannot drift apart silently.

## Public interfaces (typed)

| Layer | Function | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| tools | `contracts.case_conformance(case)` | list of contract violations |
| tools | `validate_table.validate(path, strict)` | errors and warnings |
| tools | `check_repo.scan(root)` | errors and warnings |
| tools | `ac_check.check(case, rows, base_dir)` | findings as severity, code, id, message |
| tools | `ac_render.to_dot(case)`, `ac_render.caption(case)` | DOT text, caption |
| sim | `du3_lidar.run()`, `gl3_glare.run()`, `gnss_n2n4.run()` | labelled result dictionaries |
| sim | `score.score(results)` | predictions and acceptance criteria with HIT or MISS |
| sim | `evidence.build()` | evidence bundles |
| docsgen | `facts.all_facts()`, `build.build()` | facts, rendered documents |

## Integrity guards

- `data/frozen_sha256.txt` fixes the bytes of the verification inputs, results and baseline; `tests/test_frozen.py` fails on any change.
- `sim/PREREGISTRATION.sha256.txt` fixes the preregistration, predictions and acceptance values.
- Each non open evidence item in the case records the SHA-256 of its artefact; the checker recomputes it.
- `.gitattributes` keeps line endings fixed and stores CSV files byte for byte, so hashes match on every platform.

## One command per job

| Job | Command |
|---|---|
| Every check | `python tools/fast_check.py` or `make check` |
| Reproduce the simulation | `python -m sim.run_all` |
| Regenerate schemas | `python tools/gen_schema.py` |
| Regenerate documents | `python -m docsgen.build` |
| Regenerate the evidence table report | `python tools/build_report.py` |
| Diagram source | `python tools/ac_render.py assurance/library_robot_case.yaml figures/gsn_library_robot` |

CI (`.github/workflows/checks.yml`) runs the checks on every push with free tools only and renders the diagram with Graphviz.
